title: Valuation Summary (levers)
description: Machine-readable valuation LEVERS emitted by 99_valuation-synthesis alongside its markdown, so the fair value is re-derivable and the cockpit Playground has inputs to move. It carries INPUTS (per-scenario forward metric + multiple, WACC components, shares, net-debt basis, price) — the counterpart to decision_record.json, which carries the master synthesizer's scenario OUTPUTS (probabilities + returns). The module does NOT assign scenario probabilities (that boundary belongs to the master synthesizer, MODULE_RULES Scope), so `probability` is optional here; the Playground reads probabilities from decision_record.json. Consumed by scripts/valuation_math.py (recompute / reanchor) and the /api/valuation-levers endpoint.

schema_version.description: dotted numeric version ('1.3'). Versioned rules gate on it, so an unparseable value is REJECTED rather than grandfathered as pre-1.3

business_type.description: Operating / Financial / REIT / Commodity / Holding (Business-Type Method Map)

basis.description: equity = per-share metric x equity multiple (P/E on EPS); ev = total metric x EV multiple, bridged by net_debt/shares

shares.description: diluted shares for the EV->equity per-share bridge (basis='ev')

net_debt.description: canonical net-debt anchor: positive = debt, negative = net cash (subtracted in the bridge)

probability.description: OPTIONAL — the master synthesizer owns probabilities (decision_record.json); omit or null here

forward_metric.description: forward EPS (basis=equity) or forward EBITDA/EBIT total (basis=ev)

multiple.description: the multiple this case is quoted at. Usually IMPLIED (what `level` corresponds to on the stated metric) rather than an input — see multiple_kind

basis.description: v1.3 — this CASE's basis, overriding the run-level one. Genuinely varies inside a run: EMAAR's base reads on EV/EBITDA while its bear reads 0.96x on BOOK (an equity multiple). 'equity' -> level = metric x multiple; 'ev' -> level = (metric x multiple - net_debt - minority + other) / shares. A `bridge` is meaningful only on an 'ev' case.

multiple_basis.description: v1.3 REQUIRED whenever `multiple` is present: what the multiple IS — 'EV/FY2025 Adj. EBITDA', 'NTM P/E', 'P/BV (book)'. A bare number is an incomplete citation (§5): EMAAR's bear reads 0.96x on BOOK, not EV/EBITDA

multiple_kind.description: v1.3 — 'implied': the value came from this case's own machinery (a margin path, a method blend, a runoff chain) and the multiple is what that value CORRESPONDS to, stated as a cross-check; 'applied': the case was genuinely built AS metric x multiple. Drives the Playground's two-way behaviour: editing the machinery updates an implied multiple, while typing a multiple is an explicit reverse assertion

secondary_multiples.description: v1.3 — further yardsticks the orb quoted for the SAME value (EMAAR's base states ~4.8x LTM EV/EBITDA, ~7.0x P/E, 1.5x P/BV alongside its primary ~6.7x normalized). Recorded so real analyst content is not discarded; they are cross-checks and are NEVER used in any computation

bridge.description: v1.3 — the EV->equity terms THIS case used, when they differ from the run level. Recorded per case because conventions genuinely differ within one run (NHY's cases deduct net debt 17,919 + minority 7,495 separately). A bridge on one case must appear on all — mixing an all-in run-level deduction with per-case split terms double-counts minority.

net_debt_basis.description: §15 basis label, REQUIRED: name what this per-case debt figure IS wherever it appears (e.g. 'cash-quality adjusted (01 canonical)' — not the run-level broad figure)

shares.description: falls back to the top-level shares when null

source.description: v1.3 OPTIONAL — the §5 citation for THIS bridge's net_debt/minority/other/shares figures, when they come from a DIFFERENT document/module than the scenario-level `source` (which cites only the forward metric and multiple). NHY's bridge terms trace to the balance-sheet-survival module's debt-note read, not the valuation orb's own scenario table — printing the scenario `source` under the bridge arithmetic would misattribute those figures. Falls back to the scenario-level `source` when the bridge terms come from the same place and this is omitted (Codex #365 P1).

v1.3 REQUIRED whenever forward_metric/multiple is present: the §5 citation the metric and multiple came from (e.g. '07_scenario-and-fair-value.md §2 scenario table'). The scenario levers are the Playground's most-edited inputs and are held to the same citation bar as dcf_grid / sotp_bridge / peers_internals / derivation

level.description: the derived per-share fair-value LEVEL (= metric x multiple, bridged for basis='ev'); price-independent

drivers.description: one line: the operating drivers behind this case

derivation.description: v1.2 OPTIONAL — the scenario's OWN recorded derivation chain, transcribed from the orb's executed snippet (REPRODUCE-or-omit: the chain must reproduce `level` within tolerance, or be omitted). Records the figures actually used, so the Playground makes them the editable inputs and computes the level. First model: ev_bridge = (ev − net_debt − minority + other) / shares. stated_drivers carries the narrative assumptions BEHIND a recorded figure (e.g. 'terminal Adj. EBITDA margin 9.0%') whose mapping to that figure the orb did NOT record — display-only provenance, never an invented lever.

model.description: the chain's shape; future models extend this enum (a reader treats an unknown model as not-recorded)

ev.description: enterprise value under this scenario, in the filing's own millions. For ev_bridge it is the lever; for margin_runoff_dcf it is the RECORDED anchor the replayed chain must reproduce (guard-checked)

margin.description: margin_runoff_dcf lever: terminal margin as a decimal (0.09 = 9.0%)

growth.description: margin_runoff_dcf lever: perpetuity growth as a decimal (−0.01 = declining 1%/yr); wacc − growth must be > 0

tax.description: margin_runoff_dcf: tax rate as a decimal (absent → 0)

revenue_base.description: margin_runoff_dcf constant: the recorded revenue base the margin applies to

wacc.description: margin_runoff_dcf constant: the discount rate used in the recorded TV denominator. NOT a lever here — it also sits inside pv_factor and pv_explicit, whose WACC-sensitivity the orb did not record

pv_factor.description: margin_runoff_dcf constant: the recorded discount factor applied to the terminal value

pv_explicit.description: margin_runoff_dcf constant: the recorded PV of the explicit years added to the discounted TV

metric_label.description: what the margin is a margin OF (e.g. 'terminal Adj. EBITDA margin') — display label

net_debt.description: REQUIRED, explicit even when 0 — the bridge's own net-debt term for THIS scenario (unknown net debt is never silently 0, §15)

net_debt_basis.description: §15 basis label for the chain's net-debt term when it departs from the top-level basis (e.g. 'cash-quality adjusted (01 canonical)')

other.description: any further bridge term the orb recorded (+ adds to equity)

shares.description: diluted shares; falls back to the top-level shares when null

stated_drivers.description: narrative assumptions behind the recorded figures — provenance chips, not levers

note.description: why this is display-only (e.g. 'impaired-FCFF DCF input — its mapping to EV is not recorded')

source.description: REQUIRED §5 citation of the orb section / executed snippet the chain is transcribed from — editable levers cannot ship uncited

methods.description: cross-method football field {own_history, peers, dcf, sotp: per-share value or null}

method_weights.description: effective base-point weights per method (multiples-first policy)

method_basis.description: v1.4 — the PERIOD BASIS behind each method's value {own_history, peers, dcf, sotp: 'NTM' | 'FY+1' | 'LTM' | 'trailing' | null}. Load-bearing, not documentation: a method valued on a TRAILING period may not carry base-point weight (06_sum-of-the-parts: 'a trailing SOTP may appear only as a labelled sanity check, never as a weighted method feeding 07'). Without this field the guard can validate that the blend adds up but not what it added up.

method_weight_exception.description: v1.4 — a CITED sentence naming which MODULE_RULES Scenario Construction §1 exception licenses a base point that departs from multiples-first (a genuine multi-segment conglomerate where SOTP is primary per the Method Map; or no usable forward multiple). Present only when the departure is real. An undeclared departure fails the integrity guard — the policy is a hard rule, and an exception that is merely implied in prose is how it came to be read as advisory.

is_developed_mega_cap.description: enables the Gate-4 developed-market mega-cap cost-of-equity ceiling

dcf_grid.description: v1.1 (P-C sub-levers) — the DCF orb's OWN recorded WACC × terminal-growth sensitivity grid (04_intrinsic-dcf §7), transcribed verbatim so the Playground can derive the DCF method value from typed WACC/growth fields. Values between recorded points are linear blends of these cells (labelled interpolated); outside the grid is flagged extrapolated. The cell at `base` MUST equal methods.dcf — the grid reproduces the recorded method value, never a new model.

wacc.description: ascending WACC column points, as decimals (0.075 = 7.5%)

growth.description: ascending terminal-growth row points, as decimals

values.description: per-share values: values[growthIdx][waccIdx], matching the orb's own table cells

base.description: REQUIRED — the orb's used WACC/growth pair; its grid cell must equal methods.dcf (the reproduce anchor)

source.description: REQUIRED §5 citation, e.g. '04_intrinsic-dcf.md §7' — an uncited lever cannot ship

sotp_segments.description: v1.1 (P-C sub-levers) — the SOTP orb's OWN per-segment metric × multiple rows (06_sum-of-the-parts), transcribed verbatim so each segment multiple is a typed lever. Σ(metric × multiple) + sotp_bridge must reproduce methods.sotp through the shares bridge.

metric_name.description: e.g. 'LTM Adj. EBITDA' — the basis the multiple applies to

metric.description: the segment metric value (company currency, millions)

comp.description: the named comparable behind the multiple

sotp_bridge.description: v1.1 — the recorded EV→equity bridge for the SOTP re-sum: per-share = (Σ segment EVs − net_debt − minority + other) / shares (top-level `shares`). Amounts in company currency, millions; positive values are subtracted for net_debt/minority, added for `other`. REQUIRED alongside sotp_segments — a re-sum with no recorded bridge would silently value the firm as debt-free (§15); a truly debt-free firm records an explicit 0.

net_debt.description: REQUIRED — explicit, even when 0 (unknown net debt is never silently 0, §15)

other.description: net other bridge items (+ additions, − subtractions), 0/null when none

peers_internals.description: v1.1 (P-C sub-levers) — the peers orb's OWN implied-value line (03_relative-valuation-peers §5): two verbatim anchor rows (multiple → per-share value) define the affine map the Playground moves along; the lever is the discount % off the peer median. anchors[0] at applied_multiple must equal methods.peers.

applied_multiple.description: the multiple the base case used (median × (1 − discount))

discount_pct.description: the recorded quality discount off the median, in percent (10 = 10%)

anchors.description: verbatim rows from the orb's implied-value table, ALL honored: the client interpolates piecewise through every recorded row (sorted by multiple), not just the first two
